prerequisites: Performance evaluation course (Petri nets) seen in S7 Common Core.

learning_outcomes.text: Be introduced to the modelling and simulation of complex systems as well as to the analysis and improvement of system performance.
Understand the basic principles of discrete simulation.
Use the Witness software to model and analyze production systems.
Interpret simulation results and suggest improvements.

syllabus_topics: Definition and importance of discrete simulation
The main stages in the process
Presentation of the tool & Demonstrations (Branch.mod, Maintenance.mod)
Visual Representation and Colour Code of Elements
Examples of combined use (WAIT, PUSH, PULL)
Illustrative example: Demo of a simple simulation model
The special item: Route and Buffer routing law
Illustrative example: Demo of a simple simulation model
Practical exercise 1: Creation of a Basic Model
Creation of a production model with concepts of passive and active items, machines and stocks
Execution and analysis of the results
Raising awareness of model validation, highlighting flows, capacities and bottlenecks
Practical exercise 2: Enhancing the Basic Model
Integrate the concept of production routings and analyse their contribution to improving the routing of items
Integrate resources and understand the differences between activity resources and process resources
Integrate the concepts of assembly machines, production machines and multi-cycle machines and understand the differences between types of machine
Execute and analyse the results for each type of integrated element
Practical exercise 3: Modelling a real system
Choosing the case study to be modelled by drawing lots from a portfolio of case studies
Creation of the model using the advanced features of Witness
Analysis of the results and suggestions for improvements
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is based solely on Practical work 1 (1*TP1)/1.
